steps: Customer Obsession: Leaders start with the customer and work backwards. They work to earn and keep customer trust by delivering on promises and providing exceptional service.
Ownership: Leaders act on behalf of the entire company, beyond just their own team. They think long term and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.
Invent and Simplify: Leaders are always looking for new ways to innovate and improve. They seek to simplify processes and eliminate unnecessary complexity.
Are Right, A Lot: Leaders have strong judgment and good instincts. They make decisions based on data and are not afraid to be wrong, but they learn from their mistakes.
Learn and Be Curious: Leaders are constantly learning and seeking out new opportunities for growth. They are curious and open to new ideas and perspectives.
Hire and Develop the Best: Leaders hire and develop top talent, and they set high standards for themselves and their team. They are committed to helping others succeed.
Insist on the Highest Standards: Leaders have a relentless pursuit of excellence and set high standards for themselves and their team. They continuously raise the bar for performance and quality.
